PR title:
feat: improve consistency of many arg with nested schema

PR body:
For nested field, we can get some inconsistencies between `field.many` and `field.schema.many`.

Here is a proposal to handle inconsistency edge cases (see tests).

PS: Such inconsistencies have some effects on automatic  swagger generation in `flask_appbuilder` (and thus in projects using it, as `superset`).
This will solve https://github.com/apache/superset/issues/33884.

message.content: When a `Nested` field is used with a schema instance, the `many` argument passed to the `Nested` field is ignored, and the schema instance's own `many` value is used instead. This causes inconsistent behavior between `field.many` and `field.schema.many`, which can lead to incorrect serialization/deserialization of nested collections and issues in downstream tools like automatic Swagger generation.
